sentences.text: ( IA No.175691/2024-EXEMPTION FROM FILING C/C OF THE IMPUGNED  JUDGMENT and IA No.175692/2024-EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T.)
Date : 14-08-2024 This petition was called on for hearing today.

CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DIPANKAR DATTA  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRASHANT KUMAR MISHRA  For Petitioner(s) Mr. Rohit Kumar Singh, AOR  Mr. Rana Prashant, Adv.
 Mr. Shivam Sharma, Adv.
 Mr. Akash Kumar, Adv.
 Ms. Kanupriya Tiwari, Adv.
 Mr. Abhishek Sharma, Adv.

For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.
Issue notice returnable in four weeks.

2. The petitioners shall not be arrested in connection with FIR No. 563/2023 dated 4th October,
2023 registered with Police Station Harnaut, District-Nalanda, Bihar under Sections 467, 468, 420,
120(b) and 34, IPC, till the next date of hearing; however, they shall join investigation as and when called upon to do so by the Investigating Officer.

(JATINDER KAUR) (SUDHIR KUMAR SHA  P.S. to REGISTRAR COURT MASTER (N Pikol Chaudhary vs The State Of Bihar on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124833981/
